label: Hogwarts Legacy sandboxes
description: How Hogwarts Legacy sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Pak mods go in Phoenix/Content/Paks/~mods; Blueprint 'LogicMods' paks go in Phoenix/Content/Paks/LogicMods.

Anything beyond plain pak replacement needs UE4SS, which is not a mod and which this app does not install. Unpack it into the game's Win64 binaries folder once; its Lua mods then deploy under its Mods folder.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
